        <meta name="citation_title" content="2020 Hurricanes Laura and Marco predictive and post-storm survey instruments">
        <meta name="citation_publication_date" content="2023-06-29T14:11:55+00:00">
        <meta name="citation_doi" content="10.17603/ds2-j9hc-xy24">
        <meta name="citation_description" content="These two survey instruments were developed and used to collect longitudinal panel survey data (i.e., repeated surveys of the same people) for Hurricanes Laura and Marco in 2020. The predictive waves survey instrument was rapidly deployed and fielded three times over the course of a few days as the hurricanes were threatening and approaching landfall. Each wave was fielded for approximately 18 to 24 hours with an 18- to 24-hour interval in between. The post-storm wave survey instrument was fielded one time after the hurricanes dissipated. It was fielded 8 days after the final predictive survey wave, and it was fielded for 11 days.">

        <meta name="citation_description" content="This mission focused on understanding how people’s information seeking behaviors, risk perceptions, and protective actions evolved in the days before, during, and after Hurricanes Laura and Marco (2020) impacted the U.S. mainland.  Longitudinal panel survey data  (i.e., repeated surveys of the same people) were collected from residents of Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, and the western half of Florida who resided within 50 miles of the coast.  This mission includes three social science collections; 1) the area sampling frame, 2) the wide format survey data collected from our four fielding waves that has been cleaned, relabelled, and recoded for analysis, and 3) the cleaned, relabelled, and recoded survey data transformed to long (person-period) format that has been integrated with official weather-related risk products data.     ];
    const pathsToPDFs = [
        /\.pdf/
    ];
    // NOTE: Some links have `target="_blank"` even though they should not
    const pathsOfManualNewTabLinks = document.querySelectorAll(
        '[target="_blank"]:not([aria-describedby])'
    );

    /** Adds accessibility attribute to links that open in new tab */
    function supportA11y( link ) {
        const hasA11yNote = link.querySelector('span.sr-only');
        const hasA11yDesc = link.hasAttribute('aria-describedby');

        if ( ! hasA11yNote && ! hasA11yDesc ) {
            link.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'msg-open-new-window');
            if (window.DEBUG) {
                console.debug(`Link ${link} now has "aria-describedby"`);
            }
        }
    }

    /* To make certain links open in new window, and apply a11y attribute */
    findLinksAndSetTargets({
        pathsToForceSetTarget: [
            ...pathsToRedirectsToExternal,
            ...pathsToPDFs
        ],
        setTargetCallback: supportA11y,
    });

    /* To apply a11y attribute to manual new tab links */
    [ ...pathsOfManualNewTabLinks ].forEach( supportA11y );
